title: Dynamic Christian Living: Essentials for Believers
edition: 4th ed. 2017 (Student Manual ISBN 978-1-59557-286-8; Teacher's Manual ISBN 978-1-59557-287-5)

summary: A one-year, 35-lesson course on the basics of the Christian life, organized around the picture of a newborn's needs: new birth (salvation and assurance), growth (the Bible), breath (prayer), communication (sharing the gospel), and behavior (living by grace and biblical principles). It suits students new to the faith as well as those growing in it.

toc.label: Unit 1
toc.title: Birth
toc.covers: What salvation is, why it is needed, how a person is saved, and assurance.

children.label: Lesson 1
children.title: What's Salvation All About? (Part 1)
children.covers: Salvation as deliverance, freely offered by God; repentance, faith and regeneration.

children.label: Lesson 2
children.title: What's Salvation All About? (Part 2)
children.covers: Why sinners need salvation, and the terms regeneration, redemption, remission, justification and reconciliation.

children.label: Lesson 3
children.title: What Must I Do to Be Saved?
children.covers: What does and does not save, the core facts of the gospel, and the parable of the Pharisee and the tax collector.

children.label: Lesson 4
children.title: Assurance of Salvation
children.covers: Knowing one has eternal life, using the tests in 1 John and the evidence of the Spirit's work.

toc.label: Unit 2
toc.title: Growth
toc.covers: The Bible: inspiration, evidence, canon, reliability, and how to use it.

children.label: Lesson 5
children.title: God's Inspired Word
children.covers: Inspiration, human and divine authorship, and the Bible's own claim to authority.

children.label: Lesson 6
children.title: Signs of Inspiration
children.covers: Reasons to believe the Bible is God's Word: Jesus' testimony, unity, accuracy, preservation, fulfilled prophecy, changed lives.

children.label: Lesson 7
children.title: One Book or Many Books?
children.covers: The Bible's single divine Author and many human writers, the two testaments, and its central figure and message.

children.label: Lesson 8
children.title: How Was Our Bible Compiled?
children.covers: The canon, why books such as the Apocrypha were not accepted, and warnings against adding to or taking from Scripture.

children.label: Lesson 9
children.title: Can We Trust the Bible?
children.covers: Why the copies can be trusted without the original manuscripts: scribal care, agreement among copies, and Christ's use of the Old Testament.

children.label: Lesson 10
children.title: Pictures of the Bible (Part 1)
children.covers: Scripture pictured as a mirror, water, and a sword.

children.label: Lesson 11
children.title: Pictures of the Bible (Part 2)
children.covers: Scripture pictured as light, gold, fire, and seed.

children.label: Lesson 12
children.title: What Should We Do with the Word?
children.covers: Reading, studying, applying and sharing Scripture, with methods for studying words, chapters and books.

toc.label: Unit 3
toc.title: Breath
toc.covers: Prayer: its nature, importance, practice, hindrances, and the Lord's Prayer.

children.label: Lesson 13
children.title: What Is Prayer?
children.covers: Prayer as worship addressed to the Father, in the Son's name, by the Spirit; adoration, confession, thanksgiving, supplication.

children.label: Lesson 14
children.title: The Importance of Prayer
children.covers: Prayer in the lives of Christ, the apostles and great servants of God; Christ's present intercession.

children.label: Lesson 15
children.title: How to Pray
children.covers: Praying regularly, privately and persistently, and guarding a prayer time from distraction.

children.label: Lesson 16
children.title: Hindrances to Prayer
children.covers: Eight hindrances in Scripture, such as unbelief, unforgiveness and wrong motives; sin breaks fellowship but not the relationship.

children.label: Lesson 17
children.title: Prerequisites for Answered Prayer
children.covers: A right relationship with God through Christ, abiding in him and his Word, and humble, persistent, sincere faith.

children.label: Lesson 18
children.title: Lord, Teach Us to Pray
children.covers: The purpose and six petitions of the Lord's Prayer and God as Father and King.

children.label: Lesson 19
children.title: God's Name, God's Kingdom, God's Will
children.covers: The first three petitions: hallowing God's name, his present and future kingdom, and knowing his will through his Word.

children.label: Lesson 20
children.title: Give Us, Forgive Us, Deliver Us
children.covers: The last three petitions, the parables of the persistent friend (Luke 11) and widow (Luke 18), and prayer against temptation.

toc.label: Unit 4
toc.title: Communication
toc.covers: Why and how to share the gospel and follow up with new believers.

children.label: Lesson 21
children.title: The Necessity of Witnessing
children.covers: Reasons and motives for sharing the gospel, and humanity's natural condition.

children.label: Lesson 22
children.title: The Power of the Gospel
children.covers: The gospel's power to save, keep and transform a person.

children.label: Lesson 23
children.title: How to Witness
children.covers: Building relationships, telling what Christ means to you in truth and love, relying on the Spirit, and following up.

children.label: Lesson 24
children.title: Sin and Its Penalty
children.covers: Presenting the first gospel truths: all have sinned against God, and sin brings physical and spiritual death.

children.label: Lesson 25
children.title: Trusting Christ as Savior
children.covers: Christ's substitutionary death, the Spirit's work in drawing people, and leading someone to trust Christ.

children.label: Lesson 26
children.title: Handling Questions and Objections
children.covers: Answering common objections to the gospel with right attitudes.

children.label: Lesson 27
children.title: Following Up
children.covers: Discipling new believers: daily habits of focusing on Jesus, Bible reading and prayer, telling others, and joining a local church.

toc.label: Unit 5
toc.title: Behavior
toc.covers: Grace-based Christian conduct: principles, God's will, friendship, church, and spiritual disciplines.

children.label: Lesson 28
children.title: The Gospel and Grace
children.covers: Grace as the ground of both salvation and sanctification (Galatians), and grace as no license to sin.

children.label: Lesson 29
children.title: Rules and Principles
children.covers: The difference between rules and principles drawn from God's character, and when to obey authority.

children.label: Lesson 30
children.title: The First Claim Principle
children.covers: Christ's first claim on the believer's life, idols, and servanthood.

children.label: Lesson 31
children.title: Living by Biblical Principles
children.covers: Principles of holiness, light and darkness, right thinking, the weaker believer, fleeing temptation, and sexual discipline.

children.label: Lesson 32
children.title: Finding God's Will
children.covers: God's sovereign, moral and individual will, making wise decisions, and trusting God in trials.

children.label: Lesson 33
children.title: Friendship
children.covers: Marks of right and wrong friends and building friendships on love, truth and trust.

children.label: Lesson 34
children.title: The Church
children.covers: The universal and local church, its functions in the early church, and its purpose of growing in Christlikeness.

children.label: Lesson 35
children.title: Spiritual Disciplines
children.covers: Spiritual disciplines as means God uses for growth, a personal plan, and course review.

notes: The school's book list says 'Dynamic Christian Leadership' with no ISBN, but the course it serves is named 'Bible I: Dynamic Christian Living' in the Yorkville catalog, and the catalog's description (salvation, biblical truths, prayer, living out one's faith) matches this Positive Action title. Positive Action sells no title called 'Dynamic Christian Leadership', so this outline is for Dynamic Christian Living. The edition is the one sold now (4th ed. 2017); it is assumed because the school list gives no ISBN. Retailers list it as 'Dynamic Christian Living: Basics of the Christian Life'; the 4th-edition title page reads 'Essentials for Believers'. The publisher recommends grades 7-9. Lesson 25 is 'Trusting Christ as Savior' in the Student Manual and 'Trusting Christ for Salvation' in the Teacher's Manual.
